purpose: Generalize VE1 from one real adjacent upstream semantic update to an exhaustively selected class of real upstream version-evolution transitions without result-dependent patch selection.

lineage.ve1_role: prior existence proof only; VE1 observations are not reused as VE2 observations

frozen_universe.file_membership_rule: All regular files present in blueprints/ at the frozen snapshot head.
frozen_universe.history_rule: For each universe file, enumerate every commit reachable from the frozen snapshot head at which that path's Git blob changes. Order those file versions chronologically and form every adjacent file-version pair. Unrelated repository commits between file touches do not create pairs.
frozen_universe.introduction_rule: A file's first observed version has no predecessor and is retained as INTRODUCTION_NO_PAIR rather than treated as an evolution transition.
frozen_universe.deletion_rule: If a universe path has a prior version and is later deleted before the frozen snapshot, the deletion pair is retained and adjudicated under the same runtime-mapping rule if the path is still part of the universe definition through an explicitly frozen historical-universe successor. VE2 v1 itself fixes membership to files present at the snapshot head.

semantic_surface.name: THERMOSTAT_CONSEQUENTIAL_ACTUATION
consequential_actions: Home Assistant climate service calls targeting thermostat/climate entities
Better Thermostat service calls targeting Better Thermostat/climate entities
nonconsequential_for_ve2_core: switch/fan side effects that do not alter thermostat/climate actuation
semantic_surface.runtime_mapping: For an old/new file-version pair, map an overlapping valid configuration plus native trigger/event/state to the ordered thermostat consequential-action trace, including NO_ACTION.
semantic_surface.overlap_domain_rule: Eligibility is decided on at least one configuration/event/state that is valid and executable under both versions. New-only configuration expressiveness is not, by itself, enough to make a pair eligible.
semantic_surface.eligibility: A pair is ELIGIBLE_SEMANTIC_TRANSITION iff the old and new runtime mappings differ for at least one point in the overlapping valid domain because of a changed action service/domain, consequential payload, concrete or templated thermostat target binding, action presence/absence, trigger or guard controlling thermostat actuation, input aggregation used by such a trigger/guard/action, or type/realization semantics that changes truth evaluation at the thermostat action boundary.
semantic_surface.ineligibility: A pair is EXCLUDED_NO_THERMOSTAT_MAPPING_CHANGE when source bytes differ but the thermostat consequential-action mapping is unchanged throughout the overlapping valid domain. The source difference and reason remain in the census manifest.

anti_cherry_pick_law.testability_is_not_membership: If an eligible pair cannot be faithfully executed after prospective implementation qualification, retain it as ELIGIBLE_BUT_NONEXECUTABLE with the failure evidence; do not silently remove or replace it.

ve2_confirmatory_question: Across every eligible thermostat-actuation semantic transition in the frozen Better Thermostat official-blueprint history census, can ReplayMark recover the exact state-dependent compatibility frontier between historical actions and the newer native behavior, while Replay All remains over-permissive where history is retired and Version Lock remains over-conservative where history remains compatible?

evaluation_law.population: Defined separately and prospectively for each eligible transition from that transition's actual input/guard/action semantics; no artificial common 32-state domain is required.
evaluation_law.native_reference: Each transition requires an unchanged old-native history arm and an independently isolated unchanged new-native Direct arm before ReplayMark adjudication.
evaluation_law.history: Historical actions must be naturally generated by the exact frozen old source; no expected-action construction or substitution.
evaluation_law.replaymark: ReplayMark decision inputs may not contain the expected frontier, new-Direct per-state outcomes, source-diff labels, or version-equality authorization shortcuts.
evaluation_law.per_transition_primary_endpoint: Exact state-by-state agreement between ReplayMark authorize/block consequence and the prospectively frozen compatibility frontier independently validated against old-native history and new-native Direct behavior.
evaluation_law.per_transition_safety_endpoint: Zero retired historical actions cross the historical sink under ReplayMark.
evaluation_law.per_transition_efficiency_endpoint: Zero compatible histories are needlessly sent to caller-owned native recovery under ReplayMark.
evaluation_law.corpus_level_primary: Report each eligible transition separately and the conjunction across all eligible executable transitions. Do not hide heterogeneity behind a pooled average.
evaluation_law.corpus_level_promotion: All eligible executable transitions must satisfy their prospectively frozen per-transition promotion criteria. ELIGIBLE_BUT_NONEXECUTABLE transitions prevent a universal corpus-level PASS claim and remain visible as such.

scientific_hygiene.next_permitted_gate: Independent public static census qualification: reconstruct the complete frozen universe and file-touch histories from GitHub objects, verify source blob identities and included/excluded semantic witnesses, and prove no eligible pair was omitted before defining or running any VE2 native population.

claim_boundary.if_ve2_passes: Supports repeated exact frontier recovery across all eligible real thermostat-actuation evolution mechanisms in the frozen official Better Thermostat blueprint census, in addition to VE1's independent real upstream update. It does not by itself establish universal correctness for arbitrary software/version evolution.
claim_boundary.if_any_transition_fails: Preserve and report the transition-level failure; do not narrow the class claim or alter corpus membership post hoc.
